feed.subtitle: Bespoke British architectural cabinetry and joinery specifications.

entry.title: Bespoke Cabinetry, Fitted Storage & Cupboards | Cabivella UK
entry.summary: Cabivella crafts bespoke kitchens, bespoke cupboards, fitted wooden storage and bathroom suites direct for London and UK homes. Request a 48h project quote.
entry.content: Cabivella manufactures specification-led bespoke cabinetry, solid timber in-frame kitchens, bespoke cupboards, fitted wooden storage and moisture-sealed bathroom vanities for London and UK properties. Engineered with 18mm BS 6222-2 carcasses, FSC oak and walnut veneers, Blum 200,000-cycle motion hardware and factory-cured polyurethane lacquers, rigid modules ship direct to British residential and commercial sites within 4 to 6 weeks.

entry.title: Bespoke MDF Home Coffee Corners & Barista Stations | Cabivella UK
entry.summary: Explore 32 bespoke 18mm full-MDF home coffee corners (90–170 cm) with sensor LED lighting, smoked glass vitrines, soft-close drawers and UK mainland delivery.
entry.content: Cabivella manufactures 32 bespoke domestic coffee corner models ranging from 90 cm compact arched alcove stations to 130 cm single-vitrine and 170 cm twin-vitrine dining room credenzas. Fabricated exclusively from 18 mm Grade-A full MDF with contactless hand-wave or touch-sensor daylight LED illumination, 6 mm tempered smoked glass display shelving, soft-close telescopic drawers and optional flush worktop sockets, every unit ships in reinforced export crating direct to UK homes.

entry.title: Bespoke Cabinetry, Cupboards & Fitted Storage | Cabivella UK
entry.summary: Explore Cabivella collections: in-frame kitchens, bespoke cupboards, fitted wooden storage, bathroom vanities and larder suites built for British homes.
entry.content: Cabivella collections span six dedicated architectural joinery disciplines: bespoke in-frame and handleless kitchens, AquaShield moisture-sealed bathroom vanities, bespoke cupboards and concealed pantry larders, integrated coffee stations, floor-to-ceiling fitted wooden storage, and custom replacement cabinet doors. Every collection adheres to BS 6222-2 structural tolerances and Blum hardware standards.

entry.title: Bespoke & In-Frame Kitchens | London, Wimbledon & UK | Cabivella
entry.summary: Made-to-measure bespoke kitchens, solid timber in-frame kitchens for Wimbledon Village and London homes, and modern handleless suites. Get a 48h estimate.
entry.content: Cabivella bespoke kitchens unite millimetre-accurate spatial engineering across solid hardwood in-frame Shaker cabinetry, tactile fluted timber islands, and minimalist Gola handleless runs. Tailored for period residences in Wimbledon Village (SW19), Richmond, Kensington and across Britain, our 18mm BS 6222-2 carcasses pair dovetailed oak drawers with Blum soft-close hardware and 4 to 6 week direct delivery.

entry.title: In-Frame Kitchens Wimbledon Village & SW19 | Bespoke Shaker | Cabivella
entry.summary: Bespoke solid timber in-frame kitchens designed for Wimbledon Village (SW19) period homes. 22mm mortise-and-tenon frames, dovetailed oak and 48h estimates.
entry.content: The Wimbledon Village Solid Timber In-Frame Shaker Kitchen is engineered specifically for Victorian, Edwardian and Conservation Area residences across Wimbledon Village (SW19) and South West London. Each 20mm five-piece hardwood door sits flush inside a rigid 22mm beaded timber frame, paired with solid dovetailed oak drawers, bespoke chimney-breast scribing, pocket-door breakfast cupboards and 50kg Blum Legrabox runners.

entry.title: Architectural Bathroom Vanity Suites | Cabivella UK
entry.summary: Bespoke bathroom vanities and moisture-sealed storage joinery. AquaShield thermo-fused protection designed for luxury UK residential bathrooms.
entry.content: Cabivella architectural bathroom suites combine thermo-fused moisture-resistant substrates with marine-grade polyurethane lacquer coatings. Designed to withstand relative humidity levels up to 95 percent without delaminating, each vanity integrates concealed waste cut-outs, integrated basin supports, and whisper-quiet soft-close drawer mechanisms engineered for daily British household use.

entry.title: Bespoke Cupboards, Pantry & Larder Joinery | Cabivella UK
entry.summary: Handcrafted bespoke cupboards, full-height pantry larders and pocket-door storage joinery built to exact UK room dimensions. Request a 48h project quote.
entry.content: Cabivella bespoke cupboards, walk-in pantries and freestanding or built-in larder systems combine made-to-measure 18mm rigid carcasses with bi-folding pocket doors that retract flush into side housings. Interiors integrate solid European oak dovetailed drawers, door-mounted spice racks, sensor-activated 3000K LED strips, and cold-surface quartz shelves tailored for UK kitchens, utility rooms and hallways.

entry.title: Integrated Bespoke Coffee Stations | Cabivella UK
entry.summary: Bespoke luxury coffee stations and beverage cabinetry. Retractable doors, heat ventilation and dedicated plumbing integration for UK homes.
entry.content: Cabivella integrated coffee stations enclose professional espresso machines behind effortless bi-folding pocket facades. Each station features heat-resistant composite stone backsplashes, passive rear convection channels to prevent moisture entrapment, integrated electrical conduit feeds, and dedicated storage for glassware and artisanal coffee bean canisters.

entry.title: Fitted Storage & Fitted Wooden Storage | Bespoke Cupboards | Cabivella
entry.summary: Made-to-measure fitted storage, solid oak fitted wooden storage and bespoke alcove cupboards crafted to BS 6222-2 for London and UK homes. Get a 48h quote.
entry.content: Cabivella fitted storage and fitted wooden storage joinery maximizes vertical wall and chimney-alcove footprints with millimetric floor-to-ceiling framing. Crafted from FSC-certified European oak, walnut veneers and 18mm moisture-resistant cores to BS 6222-2, configurations include bespoke alcove cupboards, louvred timber doors, acoustic soft-close ash drawers, reeded glass vitrines, and 60mm scribing trims for British period properties.

entry.title: Bespoke Replacement Kitchen Doors & Fronts | Cabivella UK
entry.summary: Upgrade existing kitchen cabinetry with custom replacement doors. Custom shaker, slab and fluted front panels drilled to exact hinge centres.
entry.content: Cabivella custom replacement doors allow homeowners to refresh existing kitchen carcasses with premium architectural facades. Each panel is precision-cut to custom dimensions and pre-drilled to match specified 35mm cup hinge positions. Finishes include moisture-resistant primed MDF for on-site finishing, durable polyurethane lacquer, and natural oak or walnut veneers.

entry.title: Cable Containment & Tray Systems | London & UK Supply | Cabivella UK
entry.summary: BS EN 61537 steel cable containment, perforated trays, ladder racks and trunking supplied direct to London and UK M&E sites. Request a 48h trade quote.
entry.content: Cabivella supplies BS EN 61537 certified cable containment systems direct from ISO-accredited Turkish rolling mills to M&E contractors across London and the United Kingdom. Specifications cover medium and heavy-duty return-flange perforated cable trays, long-span industrial cable ladders, welded wire mesh baskets, and IP4X galvanised steel trunking in pre-galvanised (SENZIMIR), hot-dip galvanised (BS EN ISO 1461) and 316L stainless steel finishes.

entry.title: Value Engineered Riser Doors | EI60–EI120 Steel Shaft Sets | Cabivella UK
entry.summary: Value engineered riser doors and EI60/EI120 fire-rated steel shaft access sets to BS 476-22 and EN 1634-1. Factory-direct London and UK project supply.
entry.content: Cabivella value engineered riser doors (Ref. CB-DR-0203) cut multi-storey core package costs without compromising fire or acoustic compliance. Pre-hung in 2.0mm Zintec steel concealed frames with 1.5mm flush leaves, they achieve EI60 and EI120 integrity and insulation to EN 1634-1 and BS 476-22, up to 41dB acoustic attenuation, budget locks or 3-point DIN deadlocks, and rapid dry-wall fixing for UK residential towers and commercial risers.

entry.title: Architectural Aluminium Louvre Manufacturer | UK Trade & OEM | Cabivella
entry.summary: Direct architectural aluminium louvre manufacturer supplying plant screening, solar shading, OEM marketing sample packs and UK trade submittals in 48 hours.
entry.content: Cabivella is a direct-export architectural aluminium louvre manufacturer supplying extruded EN AW-6063 T6 weather louvres, acoustic plant screens and solar brise-soleil blades across the UK and Europe. Alongside cut-to-schedule façade fabrication finished in Qualicoat Seaside powder coat or anodising, we equip UK façade contractors, merchants and OEM partners with unbranded CAD sections, BS EN 13030 airflow data and physical showroom marketing sample cases.

entry.title: Cabinetry Materials, Solid Timber & Hardware | Cabivella UK
entry.summary: Explore FSC European oak, fitted wooden storage veneers, polyurethane lacquers and Blum hardware engineered into every Cabivella cabinetry specification.
entry.content: Cabivella specifies certified E1 low-emission moisture-resistant MDF, birch core plywood, and sustainably harvested European oak, ash and walnut veneers for bespoke cupboards, in-frame kitchens and fitted wooden storage. Surface treatments use multi-coat polyurethane lacquers tested against household moisture and thermal stress, paired exclusively with Blum hardware rated to 200,000 cycles.

entry.title: Our Story & Direct UK Joinery Manufacturing | Cabivella UK
entry.summary: Learn about Cabivella. Combining artisanal Turkish timber joinery with British architectural precision for private residences and UK commercial developments.
entry.content: Cabivella unites traditional cabinet-making craftsmanship with five-axis CNC joinery and architectural building-material export. Operating from high-capacity manufacturing facilities in Turkey with direct logistics into London and across Britain, we remove multi-tier distributor markups on bespoke kitchens, fitted wooden storage, riser doors and commercial façade packages.

entry.title: Trade Cabinetry, Riser Doors & MEP Supply UK | Cabivella
entry.summary: Direct B2B supply of bespoke cupboards, fitted storage, value engineered riser doors, aluminium louvres and cable containment for London and UK contractors.
entry.content: Cabivella Trade provides factory-direct commercial procurement for London and UK property developers, M&E contractors, architects and merchant distributors. Trade accounts access volume pricing across multi-plot kitchens and fitted storage, EI60/EI120 value engineered riser doors, BS EN 61537 cable containment, and architectural aluminium louvre systems complete with OEM sample kits, CAD submittals and DDP UK delivery.

entry.title: Enquire About a Project | 48h Cabinetry & Trade Quote | Cabivella
entry.summary: Submit drawings or BOQ schedules for an itemized 48-hour quote on bespoke kitchens, fitted wooden storage, bespoke cupboards or commercial MEP packages.
entry.content: Start your residential or commercial specification by submitting room measurements, architectural PDFs, or contractor BOQ schedules. Our UK estimating engineers verify structural tolerances, BS 6222-2 joinery or BS EN material compliance, and return an itemized commercial quotation with guaranteed factory lead times within 48 business hours.

entry.title: Privacy Policy | UK GDPR Compliance | Cabivella
entry.summary: Cabivella privacy notice explaining data handling, UK GDPR compliance and customer information protections for web and enquiry services.
entry.content: Cabivella processes client project data strictly in compliance with the UK General Data Protection Regulation (UK GDPR) and Data Protection Act 2018. Client architectural plans, contact details, and site addresses are utilized exclusively for estimating, quotation delivery, and physical shipping logistics without third-party data monetization.

entry.title: Cookie Policy | Technical Cookies & Analytics | Cabivella
entry.summary: Cabivella cookie policy outlining the minimal use of essential operational cookies and privacy-preserving analytics on our website.
entry.content: Cabivella uses minimal technical cookies solely to preserve active user interface preferences, maintain shopping cart specification state, and gather aggregate anonymous performance metrics via Google Analytics 4. We do not deploy intrusive third-party advertising tracking cookies, behavioral profiling pixels, or monetize visitor browsing data under any circumstances.
